name: @knf/wayfindcapture
description: Headless guided 360 capture for React Native / Expo — a gyro-only pose tracker with stillness bias calibration, a spherical target planner, an auto-shutter session state machine with retakes, and a panorama metadata reader (dimensions, projection, coverage, heading) for imported photos. Sensors, camera and upload are the host's; pair with any HUD.
